name: Akvorado
description: Flow collector, enricher and visualizer that receives NetFlow/IPFIX/sFlow, enriches with SNMP interface names and geo data, exports to ClickHouse with web UI.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Easiest way to get started is with Docker Compose V2. Deploys Akvorado, Kafka, and ClickHouse.

eval_notes: Complete flow analysis solution with enrichment and visualization. Excellent for evaluations involving flow data analysis, SNMP enrichment, and ClickHouse queries.
